data.rationale: The proposal follows the right sequence (CourtListener case search, open opinion, Cornell LII statute lookup, save a note with citation, date and statute) and names both parameters, but it leaves out the Notes tab and "New note" click, the new-tab and close-tab handling, the section heading, and the note's text format, so an automation would have to guess at several steps.
